paragraphs.text: 1. THOU, mighty Agni, gatherest up all that is precious for thy friend.
Bring us all treasures as thou art enkindled in libation's place
paragraphs.original: इळस्पदे समिध्यसे स नो वसून्या भर
paragraphs.translit: iḷaspade samidhyase sa no vasūnyā bhara

paragraphs.text: 2. Assemble, speak together: let your minds be all of one accord,
paragraphs.original: सं गच्छध्वं सं वदध्वं सं वो मनांसि जानताम् ।
paragraphs.translit: saṃ gacchadhvaṃ saṃ vadadhvaṃ saṃ vo manāṃsi jānatām |

paragraphs.text: As ancient Gods unanimous sit down to their appointed share.
paragraphs.original: देवा भागं यथा पूर्वे संजानाना उपासते
paragraphs.translit: devā bhāgaṃ yathā pūrve saṃjānānā upāsate

paragraphs.text: 3. The place is common, common the assembly, common the mind, so be their thought united.
paragraphs.original: समानो मन्त्रः समितिः समानी समानं मनः सह चित्तमेषाम् ।
paragraphs.translit: samāno mantraḥ samitiḥ samānī samānaṃ manaḥ saha cittameṣām |

paragraphs.text: A common purpose do I lay before you, and worship with your general oblation.
paragraphs.original: समानं मन्त्रमभि मन्त्रये वः समानेन वो हविषा जुहोमि
paragraphs.translit: samānaṃ mantramabhi mantraye vaḥ samānena vo haviṣā juhomi

paragraphs.text: 4. One and the same be your resolve, and be your minds of one accord.
paragraphs.original: समानी व आकूतिः समाना हृदयानि वः ।
paragraphs.translit: samānī va ākūtiḥ samānā hṛdayāni vaḥ |

paragraphs.text: United be the thoughts of all that all may happily agree.
paragraphs.original: समानमस्तु वो मनो यथा वः सुसहासति
paragraphs.translit: samānamastu vo mano yathā vaḥ susahāsati
